book.title: 小熊运南瓜
book.subtitle: 安安的大班亲子运动会

moral.zh: 运一颗，数一下。两个人来来回回送到的球，一点点装满了筐底。
moral.en: One ball, one count. Little by little, what two people carry together adds up.

pages.zhText: 大班亲子运动会上，安安坐上一辆蓝色的四轮小车。爸爸指给她看。跑道那头的绿筐里装着一堆橙色的球，脚边的黄筐还空着。
pages.enText: At kindergarten sports day, An’an sat in a blue wagon with four wheels. Dad pointed down the track. A green basket at the far end held a pile of orange balls. The yellow basket by his feet was empty.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Opening and cover. An’an sits in the blue wagon at the return end with empty hands. Dad points toward the distant green basket full of orange balls. The empty yellow basket is nearby in the foreground. Along the grass in front of the school and along the far track edge, show about 10–14 adults and kindergarten children in staggered groups. Some pairs wait at the starting area, and more parents and children look toward the track. In the distant adjacent lane one small child-and-parent team waits with its own muted-colored pull wagon. The green and yellow baskets in the lead lane must remain individually visible.

pages.zhText: “今天玩小熊运南瓜！”张老师说，“小朋友坐在车上，家长拉车。先去绿筐拿球，再运回来放进黄筐。”安安望着那堆球。原来今天的南瓜这么圆！
pages.enText: “Today’s game is the Little Bears’ Pumpkin Run!” said Teacher Zhang. “Kids ride in the wagon and grown-ups pull it. Take a ball from the green basket and bring it back to the yellow one.” An’an looked at the pile. Today’s pumpkins were round as could be!

pages.enText: As soon as the wagon stopped, An’an handed the ball over. Dad caught it and put it in the basket. Thunk! Right after that came the whistle. “Time’s up!” called Teacher Zhang.

pages.enText: The wagon stayed beside the yellow basket. Dad leaned on his knees, puffing for breath. An’an looked up at him. “Dad, how many trips did you make?”

pages.zhText: 爸爸笑着指指筐里的球。“一颗就是一趟。一起数数！”安安伸出手指，先点着离自己最近的那颗。“一。”爸爸也跟着她数。
pages.enText: Dad smiled and pointed to the balls. “One ball for each trip. Let’s count!” An’an pointed to the one closest to her. “One.” Dad counted with her.

parentGuide.goal: 让孩子顺着取球、运球、放球的顺序复述一次往返，体会运到一颗球就数一次的对应关系。
parentGuide.reminder: 可以和孩子一起看安安怀里什么时候有球，再看看球什么时候进了黄筐。读到末页，可以跟着安安慢慢数。
questions: 安安和爸爸从哪个筐拿球，又把球放进哪个筐？
爸爸为什么说，数数黄筐里的球就知道跑了几趟？
parentGuide.activity: 在桌面两头各放一只碗，把几颗纸团放进其中一只。两人轮流用小托盘一次送一颗，每送到一颗就数一下。

ageTips.age4to5: 请孩子用手指从绿筐走到黄筐，再一起数两三颗纸团。
ageTips.age6to8: 请孩子说说，为什么运到的球数和完成的趟数一样，并自己试着边运边数。
